analysis.note: Jabbit analysis. The only randomized head-to-head trial in obesity without diabetes (SURMOUNT-5, Lilly-funded, open-label, 751 people, 72 weeks) favored tirzepatide by 6.5 points of body weight; a 10-study meta-analysis (41,381 people, trials and observational studies) found 4.28 points; real-world records show a smaller absolute gap and short median use. Serious adverse events were numerically higher on tirzepatide in SURMOUNT-5 and SURPASS-2 and significantly higher in the meta-analysis; discontinuation for side effects was not different. Wegovy HD (FDA, Mar 19, 2026) has not been tested head-to-head against tirzepatide. No trial has compared deaths, heart attacks or strokes between the two drugs.
